title: TodoMVC ES5 · Mark all after reopening one task

behavior.actions: At ${appUrl} two active tasks are ready. Perform exactly three individual DOM clicks in this order, using these exact CSS ID locators: #master-toggle (the Mark all as complete label), #alpha-toggle (the checkbox for Alpha), #master-toggle (the same label again). Stay on this page. Read the whole visible footer counter once the last click finishes.
behavior.expected: After marking all, reopening Alpha, then marking all again, the footer reads exactly 0 items left.

fp_remaining.label: TodoMVC footer
fp_remaining.read: the entire visible text of the TodoMVC footer counter #remaining-count, including the number and words
